title: VS Code installer - https://code.visualstudio.com/
install: Install latest stable / choose a version
update: Update to latest stable (data migration is separate)
remove: Remove an unchanged native version (preserve data)
uninstall: Uninstall native versions (preserve data and unowned installs)
integrate: Configure user PATH, CLI and desktop
extensions: Install extensions from extensions.txt (runs editor CLI)
migrate: Copy portable data to another version
integration_all: Configure user PATH, CLI link and desktop entries
copy_target: Both editors closed: copy to %s (preserve old data)
